[Convex-hull boundary surface] 1. Proposition 8.5.1\group convex geometrySource: thurston:page-0200 For torsion-free Kleinian $\Gamma $, $\partial M_\Gamma $ has a complete hyperbolic surface structure; its bending locus is a closed geodesic lamination.
